topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I understand the request, really, I do. Gardens are a lovely idea, bringing a bit of nature closer, a patch of green in an otherwise mundane space. Still, to share what little privacy and quiet I have managed to carve out seems a bit much. I can see the eager look in my neighbor's eyes, a mix of hope and, perhaps, a subtle anticipation of refusal. It's not that I don't want to be accommodating; it's just that the thought of my space being less mine pulls at something deep inside. I nod slowly, trying to sound supportive, but the words stick in my throat. "Sure, I suppose a corner of the yard could work," I manage, hoping it will be enough.
